verification.word_id_source: November 2025 HSK 3.0 examination syllabus, official cumulative serial numbers 501–1000. Numbered homographs kept as separate entries.
verification.sentence_policy: Two examples per entry; conversational is short and Anki-focused (not necessarily a question); written provides a second, simple narrative/descriptive use. Both are newly authored editorial examples, not official HSK sentences.
verification.translation_policy: English headword glosses and sentence translations were newly authored; independently reviewed native-speaker or corpus verification is not claimed.
verification.pinyin_policy: Headword pinyin follows the 2025 syllabus transcription. Sentence pinyin generated using HSK Levels 1–3 vocabulary, ICU Han-Latin fallback, and contextual lexical overrides. Manual pronunciation review remains necessary.
verification.taxonomy_policy: Reuse the same 20 semantic topic category IDs and 17 POS category IDs as hsk3_topics.json and HSK Levels 1–2.
verification.vocabulary_boundary_policy: Levels 1–3 cumulative exam vocabulary (official IDs 1–1000). Non-listed full lexical words should be avoided; common grammatical particles, compositional forms and listed suffix components are permitted. The mechanical audit does not guarantee grammatical or semantic correctness.
verification.vocabulary_boundary_audit: Full 1,000-sentence character-coverage screen using the cumulative HSK 1–3 headword lexicon; 101 candidate higher-level word occurrences or non-listed functional items were revised. Manual sense-level/editorial review is distinct from licensed-source or native-speaker verification.
